title: Single-source social attention to hourly variance
claim: A linear social-attention increment improves next-hour variance forecasts over registered market controls.
mechanism: Higher public-information arrival intensity increases near-term price variation.

evidence.summary: The linear increment was positive but negligible and insignificant: improvement 0.00007282, Holm-adjusted p=1.0.

nextAction: Keep the linear candidate rejected; the separately registered nonlinear functional model supersedes it as a distinct candidate.
